tools.name: find_road_trips
tools.description: Search Roadcut's European road trip itineraries by country, number of days or keywords (e.g. "fjords", "Alps", "coast", a town). Returns matching trips with days, km and a link.

tools.name: get_road_trip
tools.description: Day-by-day overview of one Roadcut road trip: from, to, km and where to sleep each day, highlights, ferries, seasonal mountain passes on the way, a cost estimate, EV charging along the road (stations, fast chargers, longest stretch without one), and links to the full plan and the interactive planner

tools.name: get_driving_rules
tools.description: Speed limits, drink-driving limit and winter tyre, stud and chain rules for a European country, each with the official sources and the date Roadcut last checked them.

tools.name: get_mountain_pass
tools.description: When a European mountain pass (Alps, Norway, Carpathians…) usually opens and closes, whether it opened this year, night closures, and where the road operator publishes live status. Search by pass name or country; with neither, every pass Roadcut tracks is listed. Seasons are records of past years, n

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_road_trip" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
